caption: The drawing features a single object, a top hat, positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The hat is depicted in a monochromatic palette, primarily composed of varying shades of brown and gray. The crown of the hat is tall and cylindrical with gently sloping sides, and the brim curves slightly upward at the edges. Around the base of the crown is a hatband in a lighter shade, tied into a small, simple bow on the right side. The drawing has a soft, shaded quality, with subtle gradients that suggest texture and dimension, and no other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Man's Hat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
